description: Essential lifecycle hooks for session management, context loading, and security

hooks.description: Load PAI skill system and core configuration into session context
Detect project from CWD, load notes directory, TODO.md, and session note
Create numbered session note and register in PAI registry
Heal stale deferred MCP tool handles on resumed sessions: ToolSearch-and-retry instead of trusting a stale disconnect conclusion
Validate shell commands against security rules before execution
Correct deferred MCP tool calls: ToolSearch remedy instead of a false 'MCP server disconnected' report
Write work items and summary to session note, send notification
